summary: 12 countries. The $40 trillion US debt figure travels furthest today, carried by Al Jazeera, Euronews and, with relish, Russian state television. The Iran sanctions push shapes coverage in Doha, Ankara and Johannesburg, while Seoul and Kyiv track what Washington is promising them and what it is quietly withholding. Away from geopolitics, outlets pick up the dropped Powell investigation, a lawsuit by Democratic states over tariffs, troops on the streets of Washington, and a promised golden age of American spaceflight.
